description_en: Modifies the priority of an IPv4 access control policy for the Internet firewall. For this type of policy, the source and destination IP addresses are in IPv4 format
description_zh: 修改互联网边界防火墙IPv4访问控制策略（表示访问控制策略中的访问源IP、目的IP使用IPv4格式）的优先级
name: ModifyControlPolicyPosition

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the visitor
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction of the IPv4 access control policy for the Internet firewall. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic.

out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
互联网边界防火墙IPv4访问控制策略的流量方向。取值：

in：外对内流量。
out：内对外流量
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The new priority for the IPv4 access control policy of the Internet firewall. The priority is a number. A smaller number indicates a higher priority. The value 1 indicates the highest priority.

The new priority value cannot be outside the range of existing priorities for IPv4 policies. Otherwise, the API call fails. Before you call this operation, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138862.html to query the priority range of IPv4 policies for a specific traffic direction
parameters.help_zh:
为互联网边界防火墙IPv4访问控制策略设置一个新的优先级。
优先级使用数字表示，输入数字1表示优先级最高，数字越大优先级越低。

新的优先级数字不能超出您已创建的互联网边界防火墙IPv4策略优先级的范围，否则会导致调用该接口时出错。
建议您在调用该接口前，先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138862.html查询互联网边界防火墙指定流量方向的IPv4策略优先级范围
parameters.name: new_order

parameters.help_en: The current priority of the IPv4 access control policy that you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的互联网边界防火墙IPv4访问控制策略当前的优先级
parameters.name: old_order
